displayIdentity.body: Death releases the binding claim of law. Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives? But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.
